title: Staff Order for Southwest Arkansas Telecommunications and Technology, Inc. d/b/a Four States Fiber, ex parte. — Order No. S-37940 accepts the Staff Report and Recommendation, subject to the conditions contained in Staff's Report and Recommendation, filed into the record on June 26, 2026. Staff Recommendation
          Pursuant to  214(c)(4) of the Act, an ETC that seeks to relinquish its designation for an


area    served by more than one ETC shall give advance notice to the State commission of such


relinquishment. Further, the Act states that the State commission must ensure that customers of

the affected areas will continue to be served by the remaining ETCs following the relinquishment.

Petition into the record of this proceeding. Staff has reviewed the &RPSDQ\¶V request and the

each of those service areas, as well as the incumbent local exchange carriers designated as ETCs


in these areas of Louisiana. Moreover, Four States Fiber has not built out or launched broadband


service in the census blocks where it seeks to relinquish ETC designation and does not have any
